listNote: Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, per the Exophase and PSNProfiles listings of the official 55-trophy list. Guides are this entry's own words; every step names the source it came from.

sources.label: GTABase — GTA 6 trophy list and tips

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.earliest: After the other 54 trophies are earned.
trophies.prerequisites: Every other trophy on this list.
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the last of the other 54 pops. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC, and one playthrough is enough, so the road to it is simply the roadmap in this guide: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup.

steps.text: Work the roadmap in order: story, 100% checklist, then the remaining side and one-off trophies.
Keep cheats off for the whole run: they switch off trophies and saving.
The platinum pops automatically once the 54th other trophy unlocks; there is nothing extra to do.

trophies.howToTell: Your trophy list shows 54 of 55 earned; the platinum appears as soon as the last one lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1, first mission.
trophies.prerequisites: None — story mission.
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops on its own. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and it unlocks. It cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.howToTell: It unlocks at the end of the first mission; no separate check is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.earliest: End of Chapter 1.
trophies.prerequisites: Finish the Chapter 1 story missions.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the first chapter. Play the Chapter 1 missions through; the trophy lands as Chapter 2 opens, right after its first mission. Before you leave Chapter 1, take the one missable meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — see its guide.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 1 story missions to the end of the chapter.
Before moving on, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude).
The trophy pops as Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.howToTell: Chapter 2's opening mission starts and the trophy appears.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.earliest: End of Chapter 2.
trophies.prerequisites: Finish the Chapter 2 story missions.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the second chapter. It pops as Chapter 3 opens, after its first mission. Chapter 2 is also where duo play, character switching and several side questlines unlock, so it is worth clearing the new quest givers as they appear.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 story missions to the end of the chapter.
The trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins.

trophies.howToTell: Chapter 3's opening mission starts and the trophy appears.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.earliest: End of Chapter 3.
trophies.prerequisites: Finish the Chapter 3 story missions.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the third chapter. It pops early in Chapter 4, after its first two missions. By now the Key Cloner, Yasmani's jobs and Randy's wish list are open, so side work done here pays off later.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 story missions to the end of the chapter.
The trophy pops early in Chapter 4, after its first two missions.

trophies.howToTell: It appears during the opening stretch of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.earliest: End of Chapter 4.
trophies.prerequisites: Finish the Chapter 4 story missions.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the fourth chapter. It pops when the chapter's final mission ends. The same mission also ends the story, so the gold final-mission trophy pops beside it.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story missions through to the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops when that final mission ends.

trophies.howToTell: It appears with the end of the Chapter 4 finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.earliest: End of the story.
trophies.prerequisites: Finish the story's final mission.
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy. It pops when the final mission ends, alongside the Chapter 4 trophy. After the credits you drop back into free-roam with the 100% checklist unlocked, so nothing is cut off.

steps.text: Play the story through to its final mission.
Finish the final mission; the gold pops as it ends.
After the credits, free-roam continues and the 100% checklist opens under Progress, Stats.

trophies.howToTell: The credits roll and the gold appears; the 100% checklist is then visible in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.prerequisites: Reach Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.howToTell: It unlocks at the end of Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.earliest: Chapter 3, mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.prerequisites: Reach Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.howToTell: It unlocks at the end of The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.earliest: Chapter 4, mission Child's Play.
trophies.prerequisites: Reach Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.howToTell: It unlocks at the end of Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.earliest: Chapter 4, mission Headliners.
trophies.prerequisites: Reach Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.howToTell: It unlocks at the end of Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.earliest: Chapter 4, mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.prerequisites: Reach Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.howToTell: It unlocks at the end of VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.earliest: Chapter 5, mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.prerequisites: Reach Chapter 5.
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.howToTell: It unlocks at the end of Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.earliest: After the story — the checklist only opens once the credits roll.
trophies.prerequisites: Story complete. Progress made during the story already counts.
trophies.guide: The longest trophy on the list and the real platinum gate. The checklist opens after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — but it is forgiving: most side quests are not required, and most collectibles only need part of their total, so it works out near 60% of true completion. Nothing on it can be missed; everything stays open in free-roam.

steps.text: Finish the story first; the checklist opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
During the story, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study new animals through binoculars — 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals are needed.
Do optional missions as they appear: any 100 count, and there are far more than 100 in the game.

After the story, work the checklist line by line: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, all robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races, all 8 large bank jobs, all 39 gang operations, all 15 Target Decks.
Leave the checklist's hardest challenges for last — you only need 70 of 80, so the worst 10 can be skipped.

trophies.howToTell: The checklist itself shows each line's progress; the gold pops the moment it reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1 — stunts are open from the start.
trophies.prerequisites: None. A plane or fast car helps.
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game will do, mixed across the four kinds however you like. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy — flying under bridges is the quickest kind to rack up.

steps.text: Mix the four kinds to reach 250: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Favour under-the-bridge flights for speed; each counts once, challenges on the map icons are not required.
Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or by name on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
Keep going to 300 stunts — the 100% checklist needs them.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy list itself tracks your stunt total; the map marks completed stunts by name.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1 — most types unlock as the map opens.
trophies.prerequisites: None.
trophies.guide: Do one of each of the nine activity types. Most come up naturally while working on other trophies, so this one usually pops on its own — check the Activities page if one type is still missing.

steps.text: Do one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt.
Check what is missing under Touchpad, Progress, Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the type you still need.

trophies.howToTell: The Activities page shows all nine types with at least one done; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1 — ranges open as you find them.
trophies.prerequisites: None. Higher Focus level makes the later challenges easier.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges. The medals are not very demanding, and range time also raises your Focus level, which pays off for Gunslinger later.

steps.text: Visit all 12 shooting range locations and work through their challenges.
Replay any challenge until it clears at gold — every one of the 42 must be gold.
If a challenge feels tight, come back with a higher Focus level; range play itself raises it.

trophies.howToTell: Each range shows its challenges' medals; the trophy pops on the 42nd gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.earliest: Once drone races appear on the map.
trophies.prerequisites: None.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun spots. There are 42 races in total across those spots, but one win per location is all the trophy asks.

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida.
Win at least one race at each location.

trophies.howToTell: Each location shows as won once you take a race there; the trophy pops on the 14th.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.earliest: Once races appear on the map.
trophies.prerequisites: A competitive car helps; races vary in type.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count twice. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can skip the ones you dislike and still clear it.

steps.text: Win races at 20 different locations out of the 40 available.
Skip races that fight you; there are twice as many locations as you need.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy tracker counts distinct races won; the trophy pops on the 20th different one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1, after the mission Feng Shui.
trophies.prerequisites: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline until it offers you a head-to-head fishing challenge, then out-fish him. The line starts with a text from Cal after you first meet him.

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, wait for Cal's text; it marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline to the challenge.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.howToTell: The challenge ends with Cal beaten; the trophy pops right there.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1 — the home TV games are playable early.
trophies.prerequisites: None.
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four in-game video games all the way through. Three of them play on the TV at home; the fourth sits in arcade machines around the world. Only the ending matters — the extra challenges inside each game are not required.

steps.text: Pick a game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine.
Play it through every level to the end; in-game challenges are optional.
If the home TV is briefly off-limits during a story stretch, it opens again later — or use an arcade machine.

trophies.howToTell: The game reaches its ending screen and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 3, playing as Lucia.
trophies.prerequisites: Lucia only. Reach Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Andy's five-quest line is Lucia's alone. It marks itself during Chapter 3 after a call and a text with her address, and every quest stays open after the story, so there is no rush.

steps.text: During Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, take Andy's call, then read her text with the home address in Belville.
Work the five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
Finish the last quest, Puff Puff Pass, to pop the trophy.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops at the end of Andy's final quest.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams.
trophies.prerequisites: Work for Kenton in the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams.
trophies.guide: Kenton's line is treasure diving: seven shipwrecks, found with the metal detector and hauled back to his shop in Key Lento. He goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2–3 — calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds his return.

steps.text: After Island Dreams, take Kenton's call; he is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Clear his treasure sets: dive the marked shipwrecks, dig the treasure out with the metal detector, bring it back.
After the first set he calls you back, then marks more wrecks — seven in total.
If he goes unavailable after Chapter 1, wait for Chapters 2–3, or call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 to bring him back sooner.
Track progress under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees, or Collections, Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops when the seventh wreck's treasure is turned in and his line ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, after the mission Coffee Break.
trophies.prerequisites: Reach the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
trophies.guide: Billy's five-quest line opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once Coffee Break is done. Every quest stays open after the story.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County where Billy's line is marked.
Work the five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.
Finish the last quest, Hometown Heroes, to pop the trophy.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops at the end of Billy's final quest.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.earliest: As stranger questlines appear in the open world.
trophies.prerequisites: None — but not every side quest counts.
trophies.guide: Finish eight stranger strands — and note the trap: many side questlines do not count toward this trophy at all. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are all excluded, so count only the stranger lines the game recognises. They all stay open after the story.

steps.text: Work stranger questlines in the open world; four confirmed counting lines are Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Do not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie — the game does not treat them as strangers for this trophy.
Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your running count.
More stranger lines are still being found; any eight that count will do.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy tracker shows strands completed out of 8; the trophy pops on the eighth.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 3, after the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
trophies.prerequisites: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (unlocks the Key Cloner).
trophies.guide: Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage. The story hands you the first one; the rest you steal, scan with WAiNK to check the wish list, and drive back in good shape for a better payout. It all stays open after the story.

steps.text: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, Randy's wish list opens — 16 sports cars, tracked under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list, then drive it to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).
Deliver cars in good condition for more money; marked cars lead to new marks as you clear them.
Hunt around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach in east Vice City, where the cars you need park and cruise.

trophies.howToTell: The wish list shows all 16 delivered; the trophy pops on the last delivery.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 3, after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
trophies.prerequisites: Jason only. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is Jason's alone: smash the synthetic labs marked in Vice City, then take the follow-up quest that shuts them down for good. Everything stays open after the story.

steps.text: After Here, Kitty Kitty, follow the purple markers to the synthetic labs in Vice City and destroy them (quest: Take Out Kitty Litter).
Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This.
Finish Spin On This to pop the trophy.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops at the end of the Spin On This quest.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1 — the first meditation is only offered in Chapter 1.
trophies.prerequisites: None for the spots; the final meditation needs both characters together (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break).
trophies.guide: The one trophy that can slip away. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. The catch is a first meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1: it is only offered there, it vanishes when Chapter 1 ends, and nobody has confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it. Take it when it comes — it costs a minute and removes the risk.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept when the prompt appears — this is the missable meditation.
Visit the 18 marked meditation spots across 10 locations and meditate at each with both Jason and Lucia.
Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
The last meditation only opens once you can play both characters together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.howToTell: The Meditations page shows your count; the trophy pops when every spot is covered. Note the Chapter 1 meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, so its role is still unconfirmed.
trophies.lastSafePoint: The end of Chapter 1. Once Chapter 1 closes, the house meditation is gone for good on that save.
trophies.recovery: There is no way back on the same save — keep a manual save from Chapter 1 (the game gives 15 slots; hold one at the start and one at the end of each chapter) or start a new playthrough. Whether the trophy even needs the Chapter 1 meditation is still unconfirmed, so a missed one may not block the trophy at all.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, after the mission Coffee Break.
trophies.prerequisites: Jason only. Reach Chapter 2, Coffee Break.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line is Jason's alone: meet him in Lummox County, then hunt the animals he marks for you and bring them back. His first quest hands you a unique hunting rifle. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being pinned down, so work the whole line — all 15 of his Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, while playing as Jason, wait for Bret Vogel's text; it marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.
Do Veteran Hunted to get the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (it can be picked up again at any Ammu-Nation weapon locker).
Hunt the animals Bret marks with purple icons and bring them to him as Jason.
Track the 15 Target Decks under Map, Activities, Target Deck — all 15 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops when the right hunt is turned in; the exact animal is still being confirmed, so finish the line.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.earliest: Once cards start appearing in the world.
trophies.prerequisites: None.
trophies.guide: Finish any three collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in total, so pick the three whose cards you find first and chase those — you never need more than three.

steps.text: Collect cards around Leonida; there are 18 sets in total.
Complete any 3 sets — the other 15 are not needed for the trophy.

trophies.howToTell: A set shows complete when its last card is found; the trophy pops on the third completed set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1 — the WAiNK app unlocks early.
trophies.prerequisites: The WAiNK app (automatic unlock in Chapter 1).
trophies.guide: Scan 100 scannable spots with the WAiNK app — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures, any mix. There are more than 100 in the world, so just scan as you travel and it fills up on its own.

steps.text: Hold Up then R1 to WAiNK-scan objects in the world.
Scan any 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are marked, plus unlisted tags.
Scan while travelling between other objectives — the count builds passively.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy tracker counts locations scanned; the trophy pops on the 100th.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.earliest: Challenges are open from early in the game.
trophies.prerequisites: None.
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. Most of them clear themselves while you chase other trophies, and the 100% checklist needs 70 — so leave this one late and pick the easiest stragglers to finish it.

steps.text: Play normally; most challenges complete while working on other trophies and the 100% checklist.
Check what is left under Progress, Challenges — a checkmark in the bottom right marks a completed one.
Pick the easiest remaining challenges to reach 50 (70 are needed for 100% anyway).

trophies.howToTell: The Challenges page shows your completed count; the trophy pops on the 50th.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, after the mission Coffee Break.
trophies.prerequisites: Duo free-roam unlocked (after Coffee Break).
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and shake it off. If you would rather not set it up yourself, it comes free later: the Chapter 4 bank vault jobs always draw a 4-star response, so it usually pops on its own there.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) so you are out together.
Cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars.
Escape on a fast sports motorcycle; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes helicopters and patrols.
The trophy pops once you are out of the red heat zone — not just out of the flashing search area.
Skip the setup if you like: robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4 always triggers a 4-star escape, which pops this automatically.

trophies.howToTell: The wanted level clears while your partner is with you and the trophy pops as you leave the heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, after the mission Coffee Break.
trophies.prerequisites: Duo free-roam unlocked (after Coffee Break). Sticky bombs and healing help.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while the police stay on you the whole time. The trick is keeping the flashing wanted level alive between shops — loot properly in each one, and if it has not popped after the third, hit a fourth.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) and stock up: armoured vest, sticky bombs, Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.
Hit three robbery targets (green map icons) in a row without the wanted level dropping.
Loot a few items in each shop and, where there is a back room, break the safe with sticky bombs.
A handy run is the three jewellery stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if nothing pops, rob a fourth and keep going.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third (or fourth) shop, as long as the wanted level never dropped.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.earliest: Chapter 1 — the WAiNK app unlocks early.
trophies.prerequisites: The WAiNK app (automatic unlock in Chapter 1).
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app. You only need to scan them, never drive them — stand by a busy road and sweep the traffic, and the count climbs fast. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so this one pops on the way.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles by looking at them and holding R1.
Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic; each new unique vehicle counts.
Check totals per category under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.howToTell: The Vehicles page shows discovered totals; the trophy pops on the 100th unique scan.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.earliest: Once Combat Focus is available; much easier at Focus level 4.
trophies.prerequisites: Combat Focus. Adrenaline, body armour and a full-auto rifle help.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies inside one Combat Focus window. The window only lasts seconds, so set it up: buff your focus first, gather five criminals close together, and use a full-auto rifle. It gets easier as your Focus level rises — at level 4 it often pops on its own during gang operations.

steps.text: Trigger Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and marks weak spots, draining the purple focus bar.
Before the attempt, buff focus with food or drink, wash up at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the window.
Line up five criminals at a gang operation, wear body armour, and use a full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556.
It does not count on soldiers, police or civilians — use criminals.
If it fails, raise your Focus level (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) and try again at level 4.

trophies.howToTell: Five enemies go down before the focus bar empties and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.earliest: Once you can reach Vice City International Airport.
trophies.prerequisites: None — just access to the airport.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is actually docked at a departure terminal — the planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: slip in through the fence, board by the stairs beside the boarding bridge, get to the cockpit upstairs, reverse out and take off.

steps.text: Head to VCIA and drive through a fence around the airfield toward the plane docked at departure terminals E3/E4.
Use the stairs beside the boarding bridge; the door leads straight into the plane.
Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport; the pop is delayed until you are that far out.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops once you are roughly a kilometre clear of the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.earliest: Once you can reach Mile Zero Air Station.
trophies.prerequisites: None — just access to the air base.
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from the military air base in the south-west and open fire. The tanks sit in the south of the base; drive in through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
Enter through the gate, or take the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance.
Climb into a tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops after firing the stolen tank at enemies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 3, after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.prerequisites: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (unlocks the Snap Gun and jewellery robberies).
trophies.guide: Slip into a jewellery store through the back door with the Snap Gun, empty the safe, kill the footage and the alarm, and walk out unseen. Kicking the door sets the alarm off, so use the Snap Gun prompt every time.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewellery store robberies (green map icons).
Approach a jewellery store's locked back door and pick the Snap Gun option — never the kick, which trips the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room before leaving.
A reliable spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.earliest: Chapter 4, optional mission That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.prerequisites: The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). Your partner must come along to carry a bag.
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away. The first comes free in the intro mission; after that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip and follow the vans to their banks. There are eight large bank jobs in total and 100% needs all eight, so this trophy pops on the way. Every vault job draws an instant 4-star response.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the first vault is robbed inside it.
To rob a vault: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the cash in and the vault to open, then slip in and take it.
Bring your partner and hand off a bag (hold Right) — you cannot carry all the cash alone.
After the intro, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (finish his earlier quests, two Payday Loans, first).
Escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognisable.
Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs; 100% needs all 8, worth up to $205,000 each.

trophies.howToTell: Scrolling over a bank's map icon shows whether its vault is robbed; the trophy pops on the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 3 (early method) or Chapter 4 (automatic).
trophies.prerequisites: None for the automatic route; sticky bombs for the early route.
trophies.guide: This one comes free: the Chapter 4 bank-vault intro counts as an armoured truck robbery, so it pops while you work on Maximum Withdrawal. If you want it sooner, blow the back door off a truck driving near a bank in Vice City — but the patient route costs nothing.

steps.text: Easiest route: play the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing its bank vault counts as robbing an armoured truck.
Early route: block an armoured truck near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Either way, escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) for the trophy to pop.
Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani unlocks as a fence in Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops once you are clear of the heat radius after the robbery.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.earliest: Any time — easier once you can fly.
trophies.prerequisites: A plane makes it far quicker.
trophies.guide: Clear every last patch of fog from the map — all 52 areas of Leonida. Flying is the way to do it: sweep the map in a plane until no black fog is left.

steps.text: Get a plane and fly over every fogged part of the map until the whole of Leonida is visible.
Check the map for leftover black patches and sweep them last.

trophies.howToTell: The map shows no fog anywhere and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.earliest: Once gang operations appear on the map.
trophies.prerequisites: None.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist needs every one, so this trophy pops early on the way to clearing them all.

steps.text: Find illegal operations: they show as yellow map icons when you get near them, and many mark themselves from story progress.
Rob one operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Track per-gang progress under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
Keep going to all 39 operations; 100% completion needs them.

trophies.howToTell: The Gangs page shows at least one robbery per gang; the trophy pops on the ninth gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.earliest: Once you can reach Ocean Beach.
trophies.prerequisites: Enough cash for a drink.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — treat this as a fresh lead, not a confirmed method. PowerPyx reported a method on 20 November 2026: order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it beside the bar. No second source has confirmed it yet, so if it does not pop, the trigger may be something else.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.howToTell: If the report is right, the trophy pops as you drink beside the bar. If it does not, the method is still unconfirmed — check back for a second source.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 3, after the Key Cloner unlocks.
trophies.prerequisites: The Key Cloner, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — treat this as a fresh lead, not a confirmed method. PowerPyx reported on 20 November 2026 that only one car counts: the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City. Steal it with the Key Cloner and drive it straight out through the window. No second source has confirmed it yet.

steps.text: Unlock the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee.
Hack into the Banshee with the Key Cloner and drive forward straight through the showroom window.
The pop is slightly delayed — keep driving down the street after the crash.

trophies.howToTell: If the report is right, the trophy pops shortly after you drive the Banshee through the window. Other cars reportedly do not count.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
trophies.prerequisites: Sticky bombs (for the safe).
trophies.guide: Clean out Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: three key valuables — a luxury watch, a unique shotgun and a safe — then escape the police. It is not missable: if you leave anything behind, the robbery icon comes back later and you can grab the rest on a return visit.

steps.text: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first; the safe needs them.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Take the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon).
Take the unique shotgun, the Gutterball Moreland 850, from the table in the north-east corner (golden icon).
Blow open the safe in the north-east hallway office with a sticky bomb and loot it.
Escape the police — the trophy pops on the escape, not on the third item.
Missed an item? The robbery icon respawns later; you can collect the rest across visits.

trophies.howToTell: All three valuables are taken and the police escape ends — the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, after the mission Coffee Break.
trophies.prerequisites: Character switching unlocked (after Coffee Break). A gym membership.
trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum strength at the same time. The smart way is to train together: bring your partner along and the one you are not controlling trains on their own, so both bars climb at once.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon) for each character.
Buy a membership at a fitness club — filter the map by Activities (dumbbell icon) to find one.
Always train with your partner beside you (hold Right, press Triangle to call them): while you work out, they complete their training too.
Repeat until both characters sit at maximum strength at the same time; home workouts after the story also count.

trophies.howToTell: Both characters show maximum strength and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.earliest: From the start — actions count from early play.
trophies.prerequisites: None.
trophies.guide: Rack up 500 actions that move your criminal profile. Almost everything you do in the game counts — robberies, fights, escapes — so this one fills itself while you chase the rest. Turn the profile notifications on so you can see it ticking up, and steer clear of the permanent Irredeemable profile.

steps.text: Turn on profile notifications: Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile — a demon face flashes whenever an action counts.
Play normally: stealthy objectives and clean escapes, incapacitating enemies, fights and robberies all count.
Check your count out of 500 by opening the trophy in the trophy list.
If it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile, which makes cops shoot on sight.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy's own counter shows progress toward 500; the trophy pops on the 500th action.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.earliest: Unknown.
trophies.prerequisites: Unknown.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — nobody has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with a belief that it ties to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. Do not chase it on guesswork: play normally, keep the Payday Loans lead in mind, and check back once players crack it.

steps.text: No confirmed steps exist yet. PowerPyx believes the trigger involves the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

trophies.howToTell: Unknown — the trigger has not been confirmed by any guide yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.earliest: Night, after 2AM, once you can reach Kelly County.
trophies.prerequisites: Go alone, at night.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — treat this as a fresh lead, not a confirmed method. PowerPyx reported on 20 November 2026 that this is a UFO easter egg north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County: a blinking car at the roadside after 2AM, a path into the woods, a UFO in the sky, and a dropped abductee to help. No second source has confirmed it yet, and the spawn itself is random.

steps.text: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside; the spawn is random, so drive away and come back if it is not there.
Follow the path into the woods beside the car toward the bright blue light in the sky.
Approach the UFO; it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.howToTell: If the report is right, the trophy pops after you walk the woman back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.earliest: Unknown.
trophies.prerequisites: Unknown.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — nobody has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with a belief that it comes from kicking people while driving a motorcycle. That is a guess, not a method — do not grind it on guesswork; check back once players crack it.

steps.text: No confirmed steps exist yet. PowerPyx believes the trigger is kicking people while riding a motorcycle.

trophies.howToTell: Unknown — the trigger has not been confirmed by any guide yet.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 3, after the mission Credit Check.
trophies.prerequisites: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
trophies.guide: Launder a quarter of a million dollars in marked bills through your fences. The total is cumulative across every robbery — bank vaults alone can hand you up to $205,000 in one job, so this one fills fast once the vaults open.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is cumulative; you never need to carry it all at once.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 a job once they open after Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is…

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops once $250,000 in marked bills has been laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.earliest: From the start — spending counts from early play.
trophies.prerequisites: Cash. Robberies are the fastest income.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn money fastest, so aim your spending there and it clears quickly.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops.
Favour the expensive buys: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos.
If cash runs short, robberies are the fastest way to top it up.

trophies.howToTell: The trophy pops once $100,000 has been spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, after the mission Daily Driver.
trophies.prerequisites: $160,000 in total for all eight garages.
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages you can purchase (four more come from the story and do not count). They sell through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, and together they cost $160,000 — robberies in Chapters 3–4 fund them fastest.

steps.text: After Chapter 2's Daily Driver, the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app; the 4 story garages do not count.
The total bill is $160,000 — fund it with robberies, which pay best in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.howToTell: All eight garages show as owned in the app and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.earliest: Chapter 2, after the mission Moses.
trophies.prerequisites: Garages first — each one adds parking spots to register vehicles into. The Scooter Bros app (after the Chapter 2 mission Moses).
trophies.guide: Register ten stolen vehicles with the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first so you have somewhere to put them, then bring cheap cars and bikes to Moses in Port Gellhorn and register them there. Registration costs money, so low-end vehicles keep the bill down.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Moses, the Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone.
Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots for registered vehicles.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage choose Respray, then Register.
At first Moses only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep registration costs down.

trophies.howToTell: The app shows 10 registered vehicles and the trophy pops.
